size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in the users route file, where the prompt points by naming GET /v1/users and the missing 403.
prompt: Any logged-in user can list all accounts: GET /v1/users returns 200 with the full list for a regular user's access token instead of 403 Forbidden.

root_cause.detail: GET /v1/users is mounted with auth() instead of auth('getUsers'), so any authenticated user passes the rights check.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/user.test.js > User routes > GET /v1/users > should return 403 if a non-admin is trying to access all users
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/user.test.js -t 'should return 403 if a non-admin is trying to access all users'
